judgement.reason: A's tutor dropped the task the moment the kid balked and offered 'Longest shimmy in the hive' instead, which got the kid laughing and riffing ('turn left go three miles'), while B opened with 'Not sure I'd call them dumb' and 'Convince me something dumb could pull that off', then ran the same 'Say you're a bee... Tell me...' shape nearly every turn.

a.worstLine: Could be about their eyes, but look at that line in the second paragraph again, the one about why the other bees crowd around her. Anyway, you're the dancer.

b.worstLine: The ants can make their own case another day. Here's what I can't get past: if she waggles a little to the right of straight up, the flowers are that same amount to the right of the sun. Convince me something dumb could pull that off.
